ONE HUB / TWO MODES

Independent by design.
Expandable by choice.

avokadoPro is not an accessory required by Mini. It is its own product—and an optional bridge to a wider spatial system.

AVOKADOPRO / STANDALONE

The game lives here.

Pro brings the game loop and the services around it into one local Hub. Start without cameras or towers, then add spatial input only when the experience calls for it.
